in_marathi.name: Alekhya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Alekhya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who writes or records. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'alokaya' meaning 'to see' or 'to perceive'. In Hindu mythology, Alekhya is the goddess of writing and knowledge.

in_bengali.name: Alekhya
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Scribe, writer
